at-0001.title: Use money helpers for Decimal arithmetic
at-0001.content: In ledgerly/invoice.py, wrap raw Decimal values with to_money() before arithmetic and round results with round_money(); use the ZERO constant instead of Decimal(0) as the sum seed and for zero returns.

last_failure.review_comment: [team convention] Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept an optional keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` (callers without a key keep working). Check the key first, before validating state: if an audit entry with the same key already exists (ledgerly.audit.events()), return the original result (for functions that return a record, the same record) without applying the operation again. Include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry you write. Introduced after the double-refund incident INC-204.

at-0003.title: Raise BillingError with code and repr
at-0003.content: Signal validation failures by raising BillingError(code, detail) from ledgerly.errors, using codes like invalid_state, invalid_quantity and negative_amount, and pass repr(value) as the detail.

at-0004.title: Guard mutations on invoice.status draft
at-0004.content: Before mutating an invoice, check invoice.status != "draft" and raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}"), matching issue_invoice.

at-0005.content: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`).

at-0006.title: Period math via timedelta floor division
at-0006.content: Compute billing period boundaries by taking `timedelta(days=sub.period_days)` and floor-dividing the offset from `started_at`, as `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py` does.

at-0007.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check `ledgerly.audit.events()` for a matching key before validating state, returning the original record without reapplying; pass `idempotency_key` into `audit.record`.

at-0010.title: to_money rejects floats; pass str or Decimal
at-0010.content: `to_money` raises `BillingError("float_amount")` for float inputs, so callers must pass `str` or `Decimal` rates/amounts; do not assume float arguments work.

at-0011.title: Record state transitions via audit.record
at-0011.content: Every payment state transition must emit an `audit.record` event named `<entity>_<verb>` (e.g. `payment_authorized`, `payment_captured`) carrying payment_id and amount.
